title: Decision
description: C-lane proposal to A for packages/contracts. Output of services/api/policy/director.decide() wrapped by DirectorSession. A Decision is what the compositor should render (or the reason it should not). The policy is pure: the caller supplies clock, cameras and prior state; the Decision is derivable from those. Stage-2 addition: DirectorSession stamps each Decision with a monotonic decision_seq and the mode_revision that was current at issue time. The compositor is expected to ACK by decision_seq.

DecisionAction.description: TAKE: cut to camera_id. STAY: keep whatever is live. SLATE: no healthy source; render slate card.

camera_id.description: Target camera for TAKE/STAY. Null when action is SLATE.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason. Always non-empty. Surfaced to the producer log; not the model's chain-of-thought.

decision_seq.description: Session-scoped monotonic sequence, starting at 1 and increasing on every issued decision (AI or manual). The compositor uses this to ACK the exact decision it rendered; ACKs whose seq does not match the pending slot are ignored.

mode_revision.description: DirectorSession's mode_revision when this decision was issued. Bumped on every manual command (TAKE/HOLD/RESUME_AUTO/SLATE) and on on_reconnect(). Cues tagged with an older mode_revision are rejected as stale so late AI answers after a HOLD or reconnect cannot fire.

examples.reason: target sarah unusable -> wide; current unhealthy, safety failover
target sarah unusable; no healthy wide -> slate
